description_en: Sets the default branch for a Supabase project
description_zh: 设置 Supabase 默认分支
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb set-as-default-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --branch-id br-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAsDefaultBranch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, this parameter inherits the region of the primary branch by default
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Supabase project that corresponds to the primary branch
parameters.help_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
parameters.help_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支
parameters.name: branch_id
